يقلعفوا (form IVq)
# يَقْلَعِفُّوا (yaqlaʕiffū) /jaq.la.ʕif.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْلَعَفَّ (iqlaʕaffa)
# يُقْلَعَفُّوا (yuqlaʕaffū) /juq.la.ʕaf.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْلَعَفَّ (iqlaʕaffa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
